text: Word in the compound: a debt went unpaid.
Transformer don blow! No light for compound o.
UP NEPA! Light don come back.
Light don go again. Gen or darkness?
Compound levy for transformer repair! Pay your share — see notice for amount.
We don gather repair money! Light dey come back. Thank you my people.
Levy fail. Off-mic people full compound. Darkness continue.
Tank don empty. Who go fetch water?
